<thought>We need a template that performs nitro‑to‑amine reduction. I’ll search the template catalog for reactions that break a nitro group and form a primary amine, using aniline (c1ccc(cc1)N) as a representative product. Then I’ll retrieve the template’s mapped reaction SMILES.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "c1ccc(cc1)N",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["nitro"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["primary amines"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
